narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Multi-scope greenfield work (e.g. 12-scope app pins) pays **prompt-cache cost as turns × re-read prefix**, not as "more app LOC." Pre-v0.90 DevHammer data (Directive vs baseline vs Spec Kit) showed ~2.6× turns and ~5× cache read vs baseline, with process-shaped tooling (scope lifecycle, project:render, check, AGENTS/skills injection).

**Ceremony wall-clock** (multi-minute `session:start`, recovery dance) was addressed in **v0.90.0 / epic #2990** (#2991–#2994). This epic is the **next lever: turn budget and seed identity**, without undoing one-active-scope safety or write fences.

## Evidence (assumed pre-v0.90; DevHammer / Grok analysis)

| Arm | Turns | Cache read (rel) | Notes |
|-----|-------|------------------|--------|
| baseline | ~13 | 1× | Thin preamble |
| spec_kit | ~14 | ~1.9× | Artifact-heavy, not turn-heavy |
| directive | ~34 | ~5.1× | Lifecycle + check + fat always-on prefix |

## Children (P0)

| # | Issue | Role |
|---|--------|------|
| A | #3010 | No re-ceremony after offline seed |
| B | #3011 | Batch promote; one active implement |
| C | #3012 | Quality check once at end of multi-scope batch |
| E | #3013 | Minimal render-ready PROJECT-DEFINITION / one-shot render |

## Research (not blocking)

| Issue | Role |
|--------|------|
| #3014 | Opt-in minimal consumer AGENTS profile (prefix mass) — research only |

## Out of scope

- Ceremony wall-clock (#2990 / v0.90 done)
- **DevHammer retest** (external after this epic lands)
- Default strip of all process; remove one-active-scope

## Success themes

- Fewer agent turns for the same multi-scope pin rigor
- No re-install/session thrash after seed
- Check and render thrash bounded
- Hooks and one-active-scope remain enforceable

## Related

- #2990 ceremony wall-clock (done)
- #2508 skill pin policy
- #1772 / #848 / #788 (adjacent token/context)

## Source

Internal DevHammer trial write-up + Grok recommendations; article-review against current Directive (v0.90.0+).
